Also remove Mockito usage; we can implement mock manually using simple stub indicator rather than Mockito. Since we cannot import Mockito, we need to avoid it. The test uses delegate mock to verify interactions. We can replace with a simple custom Indicator that records calls.

Simplify: Remove all Mockito imports and usage. Use a simple class RecordingIndicator implements Indicator<Num> that delegates to VALUES array and counts calls. Provide methods getCallCount etc. Then adjust tests accordingly: Instead of verify, we can assert call count.

But we must keep test logic as per original expectation. Since we are fixing code, not tests? The task is to fix the code that contains compilation errors. The code is the test file itself. Use no @ExtendWith. Use simple mock.

Also DecimalNum.NaN: In ta4j library, DecimalNum.NaN maybe not static field; there is NaN class? Actually there is org.ta4j.core.num.NaN class with static NaN instance. Also DecimalNum.ZERO exists.

Thus adjust code.

In test, replace delegate mock with new MockIndicator. Use delegate = new MockIndicator(); and numericIndicator = NumericIndicator.of(delegate);

For verification, after sqrt test, assertEquals(VALUES.length, ((MockIndicator)delegate).getCallCount());

Need to expose getCallCount, maybe via casting.

Also remove reset(delegate) call.

Also remove imports for Mockito, ArgumentMatchers, etc.

Also remove static import of org.mockito.Mockito.*.
